text_block_list.name: Streamer A
text_block_list.text:
Yaaay! Today we're gonna have a race at 
the local shopping arcade!

text_block_list.name: Streamer B
text_block_list.text:
And whoever loses has to buy the most 
expensive thing in this whole shopping 
street!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Kyahahaha!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while walking through the 
commercial district, I came across a 
rather noisy crowd.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local A
text_block_list.text:
...Apparently she's a famous streamer. 
Sounds like she just moved around here 
recently.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local A
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's annoyed because of all the 
noise, but if we complain, who knows what 
her fans might do...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Could this be what they call a nuisance 
streamer? Their fanbase has a dangerous 
vibe too. Provoking them might be risky, 
but—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Hey! Looks like things are getting pretty 
lively over here! What are you guys up to?

text_block_list.name: Streamer A
text_block_list.text:
We're gonna race right through this 
arcade! It's nice and straight, perfect, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Oh, really! That sounds like so much fun♪

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
...Still, there are so many stalls, aren't 
there? Are permits and all that sort of 
thing going to be alright?

text_block_list.name: Streamer B
text_block_list.text:
Nah, there aren't really that many people 
around anyway, so who cares if I just do 
whatever?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
If you haven't gotten permission, I really 
think you shouldn't do it.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Let's take the race somewhere else. You're 
troubling everyone. ...Okay?

text_block_list.name: Streamer A
text_block_list.text:
Huh? What is your problem? I stay quiet 
and you just start complaining!

text_block_list.name: Streamer B
text_block_list.text:
Playin' the goody two-shoes, huh? By the 
way, you know you're on stream, right? 
Three thousand fans are lookin' right at 
your face, ya know?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
I am speaking to you right now. The fans 
have nothing to do with this.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: What'll it be? Quitting? Or not quitting?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Either way, I'll keep warning you until 
you stop. ...I'm not backing down, you 
know? Absolutely not.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local A
text_block_list.text: Whew, you saved me~! Thanks a bunch~!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local B
text_block_list.text:
The way you stepped right in and 
completely talked circles around 'em was 
so cool, bro!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Haha, wonderful! I'm so glad I could be of 
help!

Facing them head-on takes some serious 
guts!

help!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thanks! Some folks do tend to call 
me the 'vanguard striker' around here, 
after all.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Is that just in my nature? The moments 
that make you want to hesitate the most—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Just take one step forward! That's how to 
start! My heart is tingling with 
excitement!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local C
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, true... If only we could've warned 
them ourselves...

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
There's no need to worry about that! They 
were filming a video, so it'd be awful if 
it got leaked online.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
She's an Umamusume, and a well-known one 
at that. That's the only reason she didn't 
hesitate. Don't go thinking of yourselves 
as pathetic!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
It was precisely because of everyone's 
love for the shopping district that I was 
able to do my best.
